title: Why this? on an Ask AI answer
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData, press ⌘J outside a draft and ask a question
When the answer shows, click the On this Mac badge with the ⓘ in the footer
expected: A popover names the feature, the model, where it ran, why this model (Mail's default for this feature) and the prompt, time and tokens. View trace shows the full trace inside the popover; ‹ Why this? goes back.
